mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id, user_id, role, message, status, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM ai_conversation_message WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT id, session_id, user_id, role, message, status, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM ai_conversation_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time ASC, id ASC

SELECT id, session_id, user_id, role, message, status, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM ( SELECT id, session_id, user_id, role, message, status, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM ai_conversation_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) t ORDER BY create_time ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_conversation_message (session_id, user_id, role, message, status) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{message}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_conversation_message SET deleted = 1 WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
